params.name: indicator
params.default: { Indicator(modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.TopCenter), isRefreshing = isRefreshing, state = state,) }

doc.onRefresh: callback invoked when the user gesture crosses the threshold, thereby requesting a refresh.
doc.modifier: the [Modifier] to be applied to this container
doc.state: the state that keeps track of distance pulled
doc.contentAlignment: The default alignment inside the Box.
doc.indicator: the indicator that will be drawn on top of the content when the user begins a pull or a refresh is occurring
doc.content: the content of the pull refresh container, typically a scrollable layout such as [LazyColumn] or a layout using [Modifier.verticalScroll]
